Wow! Only 15 minutes into your video being posted, and already 40 views. Amazing! 
A couple of years ago, I bought 2 blouse and wide leg trouser sets and another pair of trousers in viscose, in I think 5X or 6X. They were new, in Walmart (our big box department store) for $5 for the sets and $3 for the trousers (Canadian). I don't believe in buying clothing in larger sizes that are really nice, in charity shops or on last chance sale racks until they have been there quite a while and are in danger of being tossed or turned into rags, because I know how difficult it is for larger size people to find nice things. But the rest of these were gone the next day when I went back. So I feel like I rescued the ones I bought anyway. I haven't decided what I want to make yet from them though. I do kind of wish I had rescued more of them though.
